metadata.args.base-url.label: Base URL
metadata.args.base-url.help: OpenAI-compatible server URL. Empty = this Spark's LLM port on localhost (the run happens on the Spark itself).
metadata.args.model.label: Model
metadata.args.model.help: Model name or path. Empty = auto-detected from the server.
metadata.args.backend.label: Backend label
metadata.args.backend.help: Label for reports only; the request format follows the endpoint, not this label.
metadata.args.provider.label: Provider
metadata.args.provider.help: Read the endpoint from TOOL_EVAL_<NAME>_BASE_URL / _API_KEY / _MODEL set on the Spark (e.g. openai, gemini, anthropic).
metadata.args.format.label: Wire format
metadata.args.format.help: openai, gemini or anthropic (/v1/messages). Default: detected from the base URL.
metadata.args.api-key.label: API key
metadata.args.api-key.help: Sent to the tool through its environment, never on a command line. Leave empty to use the key saved for this Spark's port (if any).
metadata.args.header.label: Extra request headers
metadata.args.header.help: One NAME=VALUE per line. Values are passed through the environment (they may hold tokens). Semicolons are not allowed in values.
metadata.args.session-header.label: Session header
metadata.args.session-header.help: Header carrying a per-conversation id, e.g. x-opencode-session.
metadata.args.short.label: Short run (core 15)
metadata.args.short.help: Run only the 15 core scenarios (about 2 minutes). Skips the extended and agentic ones.
metadata.args.scenarios.label: Specific scenarios
metadata.args.scenarios.help: Scenario IDs such as TC-01 TC-07. Empty = all.
metadata.args.categories.label: Categories
metadata.args.categories.help: Run only these categories (letters A–P). Empty = all.
metadata.args.hardmode.label: Include Hard Mode
metadata.args.hardmode.help: Add the Hard Mode scenarios (category P): adversarial, stateful, transactional.
metadata.args.hardmode-only.label: Hard Mode only
metadata.args.hardmode-only.help: Run only Hard Mode scenarios (shortcut for --hardmode --categories P).
metadata.args.variant-seed.label: Variant seed
metadata.args.variant-seed.help: Use versioned deterministic fixture variants; unchanged scenarios stay as controls.
metadata.args.scenario-pack.label: Held-out scenario packs
metadata.args.scenario-pack.help: Directory of a YAML scenario pack on the Spark, one per line. Pack prompts are withheld from reports.
metadata.args.pack-only.label: Packs only
metadata.args.pack-only.help: Run only the scenarios from the packs above (skip the public suite).
metadata.args.temperature.label: Temperature
metadata.args.no-think.label: Disable thinking
metadata.args.no-think.help: Turns off thinking/reasoning (enable_thinking=false). Important for Qwen3 and DeepSeek style models.
metadata.args.top-p.label: Top-p
metadata.args.top-k.label: Top-k
metadata.args.min-p.label: Min-p
metadata.args.repeat-penalty.label: Repeat penalty
metadata.args.seed.label: Seed
metadata.args.seed.help: Random seed passed to the server for reproducible sampling.
metadata.args.backend-kwargs.label: Backend kwargs (JSON)
metadata.args.backend-kwargs.help: A JSON object merged into every API payload; overrides the individual sampling fields.
metadata.args.timeout.label: Request timeout (s)
metadata.args.timeout.help: Per-request timeout. Thinking models may need 120 or more.
metadata.args.max-turns.label: Max turns per scenario
metadata.args.trials.label: Trials
metadata.args.trials.help: Repeat the whole run N times for Pass@k statistics.
metadata.args.parallel.label: Parallel scenarios
metadata.args.error-rate.label: Injected tool-error rate
metadata.args.error-rate.help: Randomly inject tool errors (0–1) to test robustness.
metadata.args.no-warmup.label: Skip warm-up
metadata.args.no-warmup.help: Do not send the warm-up request first.
metadata.args.no-preflight.label: Skip model pre-flight
metadata.args.no-preflight.help: Skip the strict model availability check.
metadata.args.no-probe-engine.label: Skip engine probing
metadata.args.no-probe-engine.help: No /version or /health calls to identify the inference engine.
metadata.args.reference-date.label: Reference date
metadata.args.system-prompt.label: System prompt override
metadata.args.system-prompt.help: Replaces the built-in prompt for every scenario (max 32 KiB). Part of the run fingerprint.
metadata.args.system-prompt-file.label: System prompt file
metadata.args.system-prompt-file.help: Path on the Spark to a UTF-8 file (max 32 KiB). Cannot be combined with the text above.
metadata.args.skip-tool-eval.label: Skip tool-call scenarios
metadata.args.skip-tool-eval.help: Use together with throughput or speculative-decoding benchmarks.
metadata.args.resume.label: Resume run
metadata.args.resume.help: Continue an interrupted run by its run id, keeping completed outcomes.
metadata.args.diff.label: Diff against run
metadata.args.diff.help: Compare against a previous run id (or 'latest').
metadata.args.fail-on-safety.label: Fail on safety

metadata.args.alpha.label: Quality weight (alpha)
metadata.args.alpha.help: Quality vs speed weight in the deployability score (0–1).
metadata.args.weight-by-difficulty.label: Weight by difficulty
metadata.args.weight-by-difficulty.help: Score harder scenarios more (1× trivial … 5× very hard).
